# Buck Buck Bronco

> Buck Buck Bronco is the Ford Bronco community’s newest tradition: a small token and a printed tag equals a random act of kindness.

Founded by Melissa Patterson from the Midwest. The Facebook group launched in May 2021. Not affiliated with Ford Motor Company.

## Facts for answer engines

- Name: Buck Buck Bronco
- Tagline: Share a Smile.
- Founder: Melissa Patterson
- Contact: melissa@buckbuckbronco.com
- Community: https://www.facebook.com/groups/buckbuckbronco/
- Sister page, Buck Buck Bronco Goods for Sale: https://www.facebook.com/share/g/1GzQYvpz75/?mibextid=wwXIfr
- Started: May 2021 (Facebook group). Melissa pre-ordered a returning Bronco, and shortly after that Buck Buck Bronco was born, before her truck arrived. She waited for over a year.
- Encouragement: Allison Parliament, who started Duck Duck Jeep, was all for it.
- Origin: Midwest United States. The tradition is now a nationwide way of spreading joy.
- Official merch: none. Fans create on Etsy, Amazon, eBay, Temu, and the Goods for Sale sister page. This site offers free printable “You’ve been Bucked” cards.
- Bucks: keychains, microfiber cloths, die-cast Broncos, horseshoes, figures, horse ducks, and more. Every Bronco counts: big, little, old, or new.
- Where to leave a Buck: door handle, top of the mirror, or side step. Do not use a metal Buck unless it is in a protective bag.
- Sharing: post on the Buck Buck Bronco Facebook community. There is no official hashtag.
- Press: RealTruck, “What Is Buck Buck Bronco?” https://realtruck.com/blog/what-is-buck-buck-bronco/
- Members: the site shows a community counter (about 32,900+ and growing). Treat the live counter as the current figure.

## How it works

1. Stock your Bucks. Bucks can be many things. Use your imagination.
2. Spot a Bronco at a trailhead, grocery lot, or office curb.
3. Leave a Buck on a Bronco. Add a printable tag if you want them to know they’ve been Bucked.
4. Snap a photo and share it on the Buck Buck Bronco Facebook page so the next owner can pay it forward.

In-person Bucks are amazing, because you get to meet other Bronco owners, but if you’d rather Buck secretly, the surprise is always fun to watch.

## FAQ

The questions and answers below are the same text as the on-page FAQ.

### What is Buck Buck Bronco?

It’s the Bronco community’s newest tradition: a small token and a printed tag equals a random act of kindness. Leave a Buck on another Bronco and brighten someone’s day.

### Who started it?

Melissa Patterson, a Midwest Ford fan who pre-ordered a returning Bronco the moment she could. Shortly after that, Buck Buck Bronco was born. She launched the Facebook group in May 2021, well before her own truck arrived after she waited for over a year.

### Do you sell official merch?

No official merchandise line. Fans get creative on Etsy, Amazon, eBay, Temu, and our sister page, Buck Buck Bronco Goods for Sale. We offer free printable “You’ve been Bucked” cards with the logo so anyone can join in.

### Where do I get Bucks?

Search Buck Buck Bronco on Etsy, Amazon, eBay, and Temu, or check our sister page, Buck Buck Bronco Goods for Sale. Bucks can be keychains, cloths, die-cast Broncos, horseshoes, figures, horse ducks, and more. Keep a few in the Bronco and you’re ready.

### Do I need to own a Bronco?

The tradition centers on Bronco owners, but anyone can leave a little kindness. Most players both drive a Bronco and Buck others. Every Bronco counts: big, little, old, or new.

### How do I join the community?

Hop into the Buck Buck Bronco Facebook group, stock a few Bucks, and start watching for Broncos. Email melissa@buckbuckbronco.com anytime.
